org.name: Islamic Society of Ahlulbayt
org.tagline: Shia Muslim student org · U-M Ann Arbor
org.mission: The mission of the Islamic Society of Ahlulbayt at the University of Michigan is to provide a welcoming space for Muslims and other interested individuals to learn, connect, and serve in accordance with the teachings of the Quran, the Prophet (SAW), and the Ahlulbayt (AS).
mission_extended: ISA is established for the express purpose of providing an atmosphere of reflection and contemplation for interested individuals, in accordance with the sacred teachings of Islam. We are a core member of our Muslim community at U-M and firmly stand against Islamophobic and anti-Shi'i sentiment.
We do this through raising awareness, discussions, social events, fundraisers, and speaker events.
org.coalition: A member of the Muslim Coalition

programs.title: Dua Kumayl & Discussion
programs.short: Our most loved and consistent program. Dua, then a student-led discussion.
programs.long: Our most loved and consistent program. We recite Dua Kumayl together, then move into a student-led discussion on a topic chosen by members. Topics range across faith, practice, history, and campus life.

programs.title: Book Club & Dua Tawassul
programs.short: Read together, talk it through, recite Dua Tawassul.
programs.long: We read a book together over the semester and talk it through a section at a time, then close with Dua Tawassul. Members pick the next book.

programs.title: Sisterhood & Brotherhood
programs.short: Sports nights, picnics, game nights, watch parties.
programs.long: At least one sisterhood and one brotherhood event a month: game nights, sports, picnics, watch parties, hikes, and outings. The easiest way to get to know people outside the program room.

programs.title: Speaker events
programs.long: Invited scholars and speakers on campus, usually with dinner. Announced a few weeks ahead.

programs.title: Commemorations
programs.short: Eid al-Ghadeer, Fatimiyya, birth anniversaries of the Ahlulbayt (AS).
programs.long: Programs and gatherings marking major dates for the Ahlulbayt (AS).

programs.title: Iftars & Laylatul Qadr
programs.short: Community iftars, Quran circles, Nights of Power.
programs.long: Our busiest month: community iftars, nightly programs, and the Nights of Power on campus.
